gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-varta: Loud horseshoe curves and heavy diagonals make Cherry Swash hard to ignore. Varta, a sans with big open eyes on every e and a, gives that heft somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-vazirmatn: Chunky, confident and a bit showy, with horseshoe-wide curves. Cherry Swash grabs the eye with curves and straights sharing a single width, while Vazirmatn does the steady work with an s that never tightens.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Bold strokes that never vary and bowls left unfinished on one side define Comic Relief. M PLUS Code Latin, plain sans in build, bends constant-thickness letters like neon tubing and shares the heading's uniform stroke.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-pt-sans: Bold, tube-like strokes of one gauge make Comic Relief unmistakable. Reading in PT Sans, a sans-serif with c forms like open arcs, would feel approachable and professional down the page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-plein: Spaghetti-like strokes, all one width, give Funnel Display its look. Plein is plain sans at heart and leads the eye into every round letter through a clear channel, so paragraphs glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arsenal: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like curves as heavy as its stems. Arsenal, plain sans with a faint nib-pressure shift in each round letter, tucks its close-knit lowercase beneath that cord-like heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-fragment-mono: Expressive noodle strokes, never touching at the tips, define Funnel Display. Fragment Mono, a monospace with letters laid out like nails on a ruler, gives that looseness a precise, structured counterweight.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-finlandica: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open. Finlandica, plain sans with open-mouthed e crossbars, follows with a constant-width line you can trace by finger, a tidy partner for those flowing counters.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-jost: Loose nib-drawn curves, terminals cut wide open: that is Gabarito. Jost, plain sans with broad terminal gaps and unit-width strokes, rewards a slightly generous size at the body level.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-canadian-ab: Nib-drawn and open-ended, Gabarito flows outward at every terminal. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal, a sans open at every curve end, quietly carries that same openness into the running text.
